qualification: Instrumented diagnostic windows, not throughput. libc probes exclude inlined and kernel copies. Heap allocation bytes are cumulative requested bytes, not resident memory.

baseline.method: Temporary uprobes on resolved libc memcpy/memmove entries and clock_gettime; NGINX ngx_time_update counted separately because gettimeofday resolves to vDSO. One warmed persistent connection, 500 complete requests. Counts and copied bytes, not latency or throughput. Copy caller uses AArch64 x30 mapped to ELF symbols.

final.method: Temporary uprobes on resolved libc memcpy/memmove entries and clock_gettime; NGINX ngx_time_update counted separately because gettimeofday resolves to vDSO. One warmed persistent connection, 500 complete requests. Counts and copied bytes, not latency or throughput. Copy caller uses AArch64 x30 mapped to ELF symbols.
